scripts.studio: npm run scan && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: npm run scan && remotion still src/index.ts DarbyPitch out/frame.png --frame=900
scripts.render: npm run scan && remotion render src/index.ts DarbyPitch out/darby-pitch.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-bitrate=320k --concurrency=4 --timeout=180000
